title: Brazil Recalls Ambassador Amid Tensions Over Politician's Speech
summary: The Brazilian government recalled its ambassador to Argentina after a politician, Jair Bolsonaro, criticized the country's judge and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The ambassador was summoned back due to concerns over Bolsonaro's comments. The move comes amid tensions between Brazil and Argentina. The Brazilian government said it took the action to protect its national interests. The opposition alleged that the move was a response to criticism of Lula's policies. Police claimed they had no involvement in the decision.
